statusText: EA_ON / green: fresh cross-market reporting shows modestly firmer Nasdaq futures and easing oil, while no verified granular NQ sequence shows persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; oil, yields and geopolitics keep Stress extreme, with the U.S. cash open as the next price-path checkpoint.
headline: Modest futures gains and easing oil keep Tail low ahead of the U.S. cash-open test
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures about 0.4% higher and S&P futures up 0.3%, with WTI near $100 and the U.S. 2-year yield near 4.76%. Fresh but partial Finviz context shows semiconductors broadly positive but megacaps split; this is supplementary only. No verified granular NQ sequence shows persistent extension or failed retracements.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC hours, Tail stayed 15-19% / green through 21:00 UTC, rose to WATCH at 23% at 22:00 UTC, eased to 20% at 23:00 UTC, and returned to 19% / green at 00:00 UTC as available reopening evidence remained orderly.
outlookSummary: Tail is low in the current hour because available evidence does not show persistent one-way NQ structure. The primary conditional WATCH window is 13:00-16:00 UTC around the U.S. cash-open transition, with a smaller conditional WATCH checkpoint at 19:00 UTC for power hour.
